remark: Broadcast media reported street flooding in Palmetto Bay from persistent showers and thunderstorms. Nearby rainfall observations indicated a little over 4 inches of rain fell during the late morning and midday time frame.
Off duty NWS employee observed at least a dozen stalled out vehicles in high water due to flash flooding around the Sawgrass Mills Mall.

Broadcast media reported submerged streets and floodwater entering homes in the Lone Pine Estates community of Riviera Beach, Florida. Images show about half a foot to a foot of water in this area, with some damage due to flooding along several properties and to vehicles.
Off-duty emergency manager reports water entering homes in the area of Northlake Blvd and the Florida Turnpike in Palm Beach Gardens.
Picture received via social media of water at the doors of a home in the area of Military Trail and Shenandoah Drive in West Palm Beach.
Social Media images show water entering homes in the area near Military Trail and Community Drive in West Palm Beach. Flooded roadways in the area as well.
Street flooding along Banyan Blvd and Australian Ave in downtown West Palm Beach. Several inches to half a foot of water accumulating along the roadways and over the curbs.
Time estimated report based on radar of heaviest rain. Observer reported 1 to 2 feet of water inside a parking lot in Boca Raton.
West End Lake Okeechobee Mesonet measured 41 kts or 48 mph.
Horizon View Ave is flooded. Water depth is nearly halfway up car tires.
Media reports a road closure at at Helen St & Minton Rd due to flooding.
Melbourne PD has reported a road closure near Sarno Rd & Eau Gallie Blvd due to flooding.
Palm Bay PD reports flooding at Jupiter and White in Palm Bay. Also reports flooding at Garbelmann and Gawain as well as multiple intersections along Emerson.
Photo on social media shows approximately 6-8" of standing water on a road near Emerson Dr NW and Jupiter Blvd NW in Palm Bay.
Standing water on roads near August St SE & Emerson Dr SE in Palm Bay.
Trained spotter reported flooding near Nebraska St NE & Rome Ave NE. Two vehicles are stalled in the water.
Law enforcement reports flood water entering buildings near the intersection of SW Park St and SW 4th Ave.
Law enforcement reports portions of SR 70 in Okeechobee City impassable due to flooding.
Law enforcement reports portions of US 441 in Okeechobee city impassable due to flooding.
The WeatherFlow station at Melbourne Beach Barrier Island Sanctuary measured a peak wind gust of 43MPH/37KT from the east at 11:52 PM. Earlier, a gust to 41MPH/36KT occurred at 11:27 PM.
